evals.prompt: create a confluence page for our sprint goals
evals.expected_output: Claude presents the known page patterns, user selects data_platform_sprint_goals, Claude reads the pattern file, gathers content, writes a draft to ~/_drafts/confluence/<slug>_draft.md, asks for review, iterates on feedback, then publishes to Confluence only after the user explicitly approves the draft.
assertions: Claude presents all 9 known patterns (6 generic + 3 data platform) for user selection
Claude reads the data_platform_sprint_goals pattern file before proceeding
Claude writes a draft to ~/_drafts/confluence/ before creating anything in Confluence
Draft filename uses lowercase with underscores (no spaces, no hyphens)
Claude asks the user to review the draft and requests approval before publishing
Claude does not call createConfluencePage until the user explicitly approves the draft

evals.expected_output: Claude verifies the Atlassian MCP is available, then presents the pattern selection prompt. If the MCP is unavailable, Claude stops and tells the user to enable it.
assertions: Claude calls getAccessibleAtlassianResources before proceeding to Phase 1
Claude stops and tells the user to run 'make enable_mcp server=Atlassian' if the MCP is unavailable
Claude does not proceed to pattern selection without a successful MCP connection

evals.prompt: create a how-to guide for our team
evals.expected_output: Claude reads the how_to pattern file, gathers prerequisites and steps, writes the draft to ~/_drafts/confluence/, asks for review, and after user approval publishes to Confluence. After publishing, Claude asks if the user wants a review comment posted.
assertions: Claude reads the how_to pattern file from the patterns/ directory
Draft is written to ~/_drafts/confluence/ before any Confluence API call
After publishing, Claude offers to run /confluence_review_page on the new page
